scope:
Independent algebra checks for the scalar SdS stability addition.

This checks exact identities, not a numerical QNM computation or a PDE theorem.
The domain and boundary conclusions are assessed separately in the report.

domain_assessment.conditions: M>0 and 0<M^2 Lambda<1/9, minimally coupled massless scalar
domain_assessment.form_domain: H^1(R), with closure taken in the form norm (q+L2 norm); bounded f/r makes this norm equivalent to H1
domain_assessment.operator_domain: H^2(R), since the real potential is smooth and bounded
domain_assessment.upper_half_plane: The prescribed branches and their derivatives decay exponentially; integration by parts has zero endpoint terms
domain_assessment.bounded_static_monopole: Unique up to scale: psi=C r; the other independent solution has logarithmic singularities at both simple horizons
domain_assessment.zero_not_L2: For C!=0, psi tends to the nonzero constants C r_h and C r_c at the two infinite tortoise-coordinate ends
domain_assessment.limitation: Mode stability only; no claim of spectral completeness, nonlinear stability, quantitative decay, or a damped-QNM L2 identity
